rationale: The Latin anchors ducere, producere, and educere (all meaning "to lead/bring out") combined with the biblical phrase "eduxi te de terra" ("I led you out of the land") point clearly to the sense of leading or conducting someone somewhere. Synset lead.v.01 ("take somebody somewhere") best captures this meaning of physical conveyance or guidance, as seen in the Old English usage paralleling Psalm passages about being led/brought out.
